card.name: Digits inside phone and ID numbers
card.fires_on: Digits and hyphens partway through phone numbers, ISBNs, registration numbers and compound codes. It also fires on 'of' or 'the' inside stock web phrases such as 'stay on top of all the space news'.

modes.label: Digits in codes
modes.description: A digit or hyphen in the middle of a phone number, ISBN, zip code or compound code.
modes.example: Lane, Rockville, MD 20852-9782. Telephone: (800) 332-<<1>>088 or www.vaers.h

modes.label: Stock phrase words
modes.description: A small word inside a fixed phrase that is copied from a standard web or license text.
modes.example: Want to stay on top<< of>> all the space news? Follow @un

card.plain: It fires on the middle digits of phone numbers and ID codes, and on small words in stock phrases that are repeated verbatim.
